title: SprintPrebrief
description: Cynefin classification recorded by the Orchestrator at sprint entry. Lives at .council/sprint-prebrief/sprint-NN.json. Informational at this stage; does not modify dispatch fan-out or the autonomy floor. See instructions/sprint-prebrief.md and docs/design/adr-0003-cynefin-classification.md.

sprint_number.description: The sprint number this prebrief describes.

classified_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the classification was recorded.

classified_by_agent.description: Agent ID that produced the classification (typically the Orchestrator).

cynefin.description: Cynefin classification of the upcoming sprint. clear = known solution exists, path well-trodden; complicated = path requires expert analysis but cause-and-effect knowable; complex = probe-and-emerge territory with no stable baseline; chaotic = no order visible, stabilization required before tactical action.

confidence.description: Classifier confidence in the Cynefin label. Low confidence (e.g. < 0.5) is acceptable and is explicit signal that the classification may need to be revised mid-sprint.

rationale.description: One-paragraph rationale for the chosen classification. Cites the specific characteristics of the upcoming work that informed the label. minLength 40 rejects placeholder/single-character values while remaining well below a real one-paragraph rationale (existing valid fixtures are 250+ chars).

expected_loop_shape.description: Either a shape_id from standard-work.loop_shapes (e.g. 'plan-then-execute-loop', 'probe-campaign') OR the literal value 'ad-hoc' when no named shape fits. The literal 'ad-hoc' is intentionally permitted to keep the field useful before the standard-work.loop_shapes[] array accumulates entries.

projection_manifest.description: OPTIONAL list of file paths that were loaded into context to produce this classification. Captures input provenance for audit review; matches sangen's projection-manifest concept without taking on sangen's full loop-tracking framework.

stabilization_note.description: OPTIONAL. When cynefin is 'chaotic', records the stabilization step recommended before the sprint proceeds. Informational; the council-autorun loop does not mechanically halt on chaotic at this stage.

autonomy_floor_observed.description: OPTIONAL effective autonomy floor at the time of classification. Captured for later analysis of whether classification correlates with autonomy state; the classification itself does NOT adjust the floor at this stage (deliberately non-coupled per ADR-0003).
